cfg.serverUrl: Optional explicit local RingKo backend URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787). Leave empty to auto-discover or launch per workspace.
cfg.authToken: Optional RINGKO_WEB_TOKEN bearer token when connecting to an authenticated local backend.
cfg.cliPath: Executable name or absolute path used to auto-start the local RingKo backend and TUI.
cfg.autoStartBackend: Automatically spawn a local shared RingKo backend when none is running for the active workspace.
